# Single Pane

> DCIM training for data center teams: DCIM platform fundamentals, monitoring and BMS integration, operations management and capacity planning.

Single Pane (https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs DCIM Platform Fundamentals, Monitoring, Automation & BMS, Operations Management, Capacity Planning training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [DCIM Platform Fundamentals](https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/courses/dcim-platform-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, DCIM. Understand DCIM strategy and build the ROI case for implementation. Enroll: https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/courses/dcim-platform-fundamentals?buy=830
- [Monitoring, Automation & BMS Systems](https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/courses/monitoring-automation-bms-systems): $276.99 per seat, 8 Hours, BMS / DCIM. Design a monitoring and BMS strategy that catches problems before they cause downtime. Enroll: https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/courses/monitoring-automation-bms-systems?buy=846
- [Data Center Operations Management](https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-operations-management): $325.99 per seat, 8 Hours, DCIM / SLA Frameworks. Run daily operations like the teams behind Tier 3/4 facilities — maintenance, incident response, and SLAs. Enroll: https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-operations-management?buy=843
- [Capacity Planning & Forecasting](https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/courses/capacity-planning-forecasting): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Build a 3–5 year capacity plan before you run out of power, cooling, or space. Enroll: https://dcim.hazwoperosha.us/courses/capacity-planning-forecasting?buy=829
